title: Turmeric Chickpea and Cauliflower Skillet
steps: Cut the cauliflower and broccoli into small florets. Slice the onion and bell peppers. Drain and rinse the chickpeas.
Heat the olive oil in a wide skillet and cook the cauliflower and broccoli undisturbed for 5 minutes, so they brown.
Add the onion and peppers and cook 6 more minutes, until they soften.
Stir in the garlic, turmeric, cumin, black pepper, and sea salt for 1 minute, then add the chickpeas and a splash of water.
Cover and cook 5 minutes. Wilt the spinach through and finish with lemon juice.
goldenRuleCallouts: Single-ingredient spices only — a pre-mixed curry blend would need a gluten-free label check.
Turmeric with black pepper again, this time carrying a meal with no fish in it.
